text:
ken_procure: Heads up — depot flagged a thermal delta on the A1000 batch we received. They're holding 12 units for inspection and not releasing stock to APAC nodes yet. Any immediate workaround?
lia_logistics: Oof. Which depot? ETA on report?
ken_procure: SIN crossdock. Depot sent initial snapshot, says temp delta > spec on 12/120 units. No visible physical damage. They're requesting RMA triage vs repair vs air-replace.
toni_ops: Can we get serials? need to reconcile with topoff list before we commit to swaps.
ken_procure: Sent list to depot earlier, but here's the AWB/manifest they attached:
```
AWB: SG-789201-AP
Manifest: A1000-BATCH-2026-03
Serials: SNL-A1000-1001..SNL-A1000-1012
```
lia_logistics: Thanks. Depot recommends 6 repair-on-site, 6 air-replace due to thermal hysteresis risk. Vendor wants cost-share on expedited air.
acme_vendor_bot: @ken_procure ACME preliminary: repair cost covered under warranty if root cause is manufacturing. Air-replace cost escalation: expedited fee + insurance uplift. Need confirmation of CAUSE prior to warranty determination.
sanjay_sre: From infra side — we can tolerate 6 delayed units if loaners available. What are lead times for loaners?
toni_ops: We have 4 loaners in SIN pool, but they're allocated to a different region already. Requesting cross-region loaner transfer will add 24–48h and customs paperwork.
ken_procure: Two ask items: 1) Approve depot to proceed with parallel RMA streams (repair vs air-replace) to save time. 2) Confirm cost split model: vendor covers repair; we cover expedite air/insurance if depot confirms environmental damage.
lia_logistics: Suggest escrow holdback: vendor keeps warranty claim pending final root-cause. We front expedite costs and file claim with vendor + insurer. If vendor accepts manufacturing fault, they reimburse expedite.
acme_vendor_bot: ACME accepts escrow model pending final depot report. Please attach depot photos + thermal logs and RMA case id.
toni_ops: Uploading logs to case 2026-APAC-RMA-789 now. Also adding thermal_kv snapshot and pre-shipment loadout photos.
ken_procure: OK — proceeding with parallel triage: depot to run repair attempts on 6 units, open air-express for 6 replacements, we will pre-approve expedite charges up to $18k total. Vendor to commit to reimbursement if manufacturing fault confirmed.
sanjay_sre: For routing: prefer not to route replacements through EU hub to avoid extra customs. Direct SIN -> SG compute cluster is ideal.
lia_logistics: Noted. I'll coordinate AWB routing and mark shipments as "temporary loaner — returning" to smooth customs.
acme_vendor_bot: ACME will provide provisional credit memos upon claim approval. Please ensure RMAs reference case 2026-APAC-RMA-789.
toni_ops: Quick Q — do we snapshot KV cache/state for the held nodes before we pull them? We should to preserve diagnostics.
sanjay_sre: Yes — coordinate with depot. Add runbook step: `dump-kvcache --serial SNL-A1000-1001` and upload to the case.
ken_procure: Great. I'll update finance about provisional $18k expedite charge and set up ledger tag `vendors:acme:expedite:apac`.
lia_logistics: Ops action items listed in the case. Will post when AWB created.
ken_procure: Thanks — keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
